conversation.text: I need to file a warranty claim. The unit you installed last year stopped working.
To file a claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
Per the Warranty Policy (Filing a claim), there is no diagnostic fee if the failure is covered, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies.

Since the unit was installed last year, it is within Meridian's 2-year labor warranty on full system installations, or the 5-year labor warranty if the caller was a Comfort Club member at the time of installation (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Manufacturer parts warranties are separate and vary by brand, and the Warranty Policy says Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install.
